visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair sits on a black mesh camping chair outdoors on a green lawn. He wears a beige polo shirt and brown trousers, gesturing with his hands as he speaks directly to the camera. Behind him is a dark wooden fence and a panoramic view of distant green mountains under a bright, clear sky. (2) The man leans forward slightly and points down towards the grass beneath his chair, where a small, circular battery-powered fan is operating. He then gestures toward his lower back and seat area to indicate the airflow path through the chair's mesh. He finishes by smiling and opening his arms wide, expressing a sense of coolness and satisfaction with the setup.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 露營也有主動通風座椅!. [Subtitle]: 你的車子有沒有汽車通風座椅. (2) [Subtitle]: 沒有,沒關係. (3) [Subtitle]: 我們 CAMPFIRE 風透紗輕量椅有喔. (4) [Subtitle]: 你只要搭配個風扇放在底部. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後風下面吹上屁股,吹上背. (6) [Subtitle]: 哇,整個背跟屁股就是一股涼涼的感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 就跟汽車通風座椅一模一樣.
